name: Vanilla Bedrock (automatic NetherNet proxy)
author: parker@parkervcp.com
description: Runs current vanilla Bedrock behind an automatic RakNet-to-NetherNet proxy. Only the server's normal public UDP allocation is required; the backend port and ephemeral UDP sockets remain internal and may be reused by every container.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Installs Bedrock Dedicated Server (latest unless BEDROCK_VERSION is set) and the latest bedrock-proxy release.

apt update
apt install -y zip unzip wget curl jq

cd /mnt/server || { echo "Failed to change directory to /mnt/server"; exit 1; }

# Default version to latest if not set
BEDROCK_VERSION=${BEDROCK_VERSION:-latest}

# Filename to use for the downloaded file
DOWNLOAD_FILE="bedrock-server-installer.zip"

# Minecraft CDN Akamai blocks script user-agents
RANDVERSION=$((1 + RANDOM % 4000))
USER_AGENT="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/90.0.$RANDVERSION.212 Safari/537.36"

if [ "${BEDROCK_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo "Finding latest Bedrock server version"
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl --silent --fail -A "$USER_AGENT" https://net-secondary.web.minecraft-services.net/api/v1.0/download/links | jq -r '.result.links[] | select(.downloadType == "serverBedrockLinux") | .downloadUrl')
    if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then
        echo "Failed to retrieve the latest Bedrock server version. Please check your network connection or the Minecraft API."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "Downloading ${BEDROCK_VERSION} Bedrock server"
    DOWNLOAD_URL=https://www.minecraft.net/bedrockdedicatedserver/bin-linux/bedrock-server-$BEDROCK_VERSION.zip
fi

echo "Installing: $(basename "$DOWNLOAD_URL")"
echo "Download URL: $DOWNLOAD_URL"

echo -e "Backing up config files"
mkdir -p /tmp/config_backup
cp -v server.properties /tmp/config_backup/ 2>/dev/null
cp -v permissions.json /tmp/config_backup/ 2>/dev/null
cp -v allowlist.json /tmp/config_backup/ 2>/dev/null

echo -e "Downloading files from: $DOWNLOAD_URL"
curl -fL -A "$USER_AGENT" -H "Accept-Language: en" -o "$DOWNLOAD_FILE" "$DOWNLOAD_URL" || { echo "Bedrock server download failed"; exit 1; }

echo -e "Unpacking server files"
unzip -o "$DOWNLOAD_FILE" || { echo "Unpacking the Bedrock server failed"; exit 1; }

echo -e "Cleaning up after installing"
rm "$DOWNLOAD_FILE"

echo -e "Restoring backup config files"
cp -rf /tmp/config_backup/* /mnt/server/ 2>/dev/null || { echo "No files to restore"; }

echo -e "Downloading the latest bedrock-proxy release"
curl -fL -o bedrock-proxy-linux.tmp https://github.com/CreeperFA/Pterodactyl-Egg-Bedrock-Vanilla-/releases/latest/download/bedrock-proxy-linux-amd64 || {
    echo "Could not download the proxy. Check that a release exists at https://github.com/CreeperFA/Pterodactyl-Egg-Bedrock-Vanilla-/releases"
    rm -f bedrock-proxy-linux.tmp
    exit 1
}
mv -f bedrock-proxy-linux.tmp bedrock-proxy-linux

# Never overwrite a config the user already has.
if [ -f config.json ]; then
    echo "config.json already exists, keeping it"
else
    curl -fL -o config.json https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CreeperFA/Pterodactyl-Egg-Bedrock-Vanilla-/main/proxy/config.example.json || { echo "Could not download config.json"; exit 1; }
fi

chmod +x bedrock-proxy-linux
chmod +x bedrock_server

echo -e "Install Completed"

variables.name: Bedrock Version
variables.description: The version of bedrock. (Ex. 1.7.0.13) Default version is latest.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: The amount of people that will the server allow to enter.

variables.name: Backend Port
variables.description: Internal-only BDS signaling port. Keep the default: Docker network isolation lets every container reuse 19140. Do not create a Pterodactyl allocation for it.
